upstream.note: upstream.yaml is the credential-issuance spec (unchanged since 2026-07-06, same hash). The two other vendor files are upstream-schema.yaml and upstream-identity.yaml, hashed in attempts[].

attempts.note: Credential-schema service (credential schemas + rendering templates), Sunbird's own OpenAPI 3.0.1; saved verbatim as upstream-schema.yaml, sha256:59d6d6b55355ef19189066f0cd8a511dbabdd52a4015aeb557a934bb432c6a71. Its paths and schemas are merged into openapi.json unchanged.

Identity service (DID generate/resolve, sign/verify, health), Sunbird's own OpenAPI 3.0.0; saved verbatim as upstream-identity.yaml, sha256:1b70f2e9133de149c1606bc23c038b390dfbf19f880fe0a420c6ef99c4313d32. Merged unchanged.

Still no published spec for the registry component: api-documentation/ holds only the issue, schema and identity files. The registry generates a per-deployment Swagger 2.0 at /api/docs/swagger.json (RegistrySwaggerController), which needs a running instance and covers only entity CRUD/search, not claims, attestation policies or documents.

Every @RequestMapping/@GetMapping/... in the registry's controllers (RegistryEntityController, RegistryClaimsController, RegistryAttestationPolicyController, FileStorageController, RegistryTemplateController, RegistryCertificateController, RegistrySwaggerController, RegistryUtilsController, legacy RegistryController): 50 operations, envelope and search shapes read from the handler bodies.

notes: Sunbird RC is multi-component, and the adaptor reaches more than one component: issueCredential/getCredential/downloadCredential call the credential service (/credentials/...), its put() example targets the credential-schema service's /template/{id}, and its generic get/post/put/del/request reach whatever baseUrl points at, including the registry's /api/v1/<entity> routes. Until 2026-11-14 this spec was only the credential-issuance OpenAPI (5 operations, coverage: subset). It now covers the whole surface: the three vendor-published service specs (issue, schema, identity; 20 operations) merged verbatim, plus the registry (50 operations: entity CRUD, search, invite, sign/revoke, property items, claims and attestation, attestation policies, documents, templates, verify, docs, utils, audit and the legacy envelope API) authored from its Spring controllers at sunbird-rc-core@6bac77b. Registry entity types are defined per deployment, so they are the {entityName} parameter and records are an open RegistryEntity with the os* system fields. BEST-EFFORT because the registry part is derived from vendor source, not a vendor spec; the merged service specs are the vendor's own. Known imprecision in the upstream issue spec: credentialResponse types the VC's `type` as a string, where real credentials carry an array, and getCredential's response is declared as appliation/json (sic).
